description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for different dense passage retrieval (DPR) methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)," has a linear scale, ranges from 1 to 10, and has tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10," has a linear scale, ranges from 34.0 to 36.0, and has tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A black solid line with circle markers, representing "DPR w/o query," begins at approximately 35.2 when S is 1, decreases to approximately 34.8 when S is 4, and then increases to approximately 35.1 when S is 10. A red solid line with circle markers, representing "DPR w/ corpus expansion," begins at approximately 35.4 when S is 1, increases to approximately 35.7 when S is 6, and then decreases slightly to approximately 35.6 when S is 10. A green solid line with triangle markers, representing "DPR w/ document expansion," begins at approximately 34.7 when S is 1, decreases to approximately 34.5 when S is 2, and then increases to approximately 34.9 when S is 10. A blue dashed line with star markers, representing "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion," begins at approximately 34.6 when S is 1, decreases to approximately 34.3 when S is 6, and then increases to approximately 34.5 when S is 10.
